examples.english: The meeting ended whenever the torches, whose duration was about four or five hours, were going to go out.
examples.ref: 1897, Ángel Ganivet, La conquista del reino de Maya por el último conquistador español Pío Cid, page 5:
examples.text: La reunión terminaba siempre cuando se iban a apagar las teas, cuya duración era de cuatro o cinco horas.
examples.translation: The meeting ended whenever the torches, whose duration was about four or five hours, were going to go out.

examples.english: In that era when glass still didn't exist, to protect themselves from the cold, they boarded up windows with wooden planks. In turn, lighting was achieved with torches that filled closed environments with smoke.
examples.ref: 2013 August 18, Gertrudis María Glück, “El Viaje del Lector: Alemania”, in Clarín:
examples.text: En esa época en que aún no existía el vidrio, para resguardarse del frío se tapiaban las ventanas con tablas de madera. A su vez, la iluminación se realizaba con teas que llenaban de humo los ambientes cerrados.
examples.translation: In that era when glass still didn't exist, to protect themselves from the cold, they boarded up windows with wooden planks. In turn, lighting was achieved with torches that filled closed environments with smoke.

glosses: torch (a stick with a flame on one end, used chiefly as a light source)
